text: Dialog A rulings crossed twice in 10 min (Eden withdrew 224px while Rowan proposed a padding cap; Eden accepted as Rowan withdrew), so a FINAL was needed. Idea: when a pin is under discussion, wait for the other side's next message before reversing, and name one decider per thread.

Win/waste: a 224px column minimum was set without checking pinned rem padding (p-6 grows with root), so Jules stopped work. Idea: a pin with a numeric minimum states its arithmetic against existing pins.

BUG-158: my ruling and Rowan's crossed twice in 5 minutes (01M79SHC, 01M79SHF, my correction, 01M79SJ4), so three agents saw four contradicting messages. Before sending a correction to a ruling, read the inbox for a newer message from the same person on the same thread; it may already settle it.
